attributes.name: Gimcrack
attributes.powers:
Gimcrack is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits. If evaded, expend a mythic charge. If you succeed at a Wisdom or Perception 15 check, add 5 to your checks to defeat.

If undefeated, for each card you discard as damage, also discard the top card of your deck.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
